title: TikTok blames ‘moderator error’ on slow response to Perez Hilton livestream
summary: TikTok says its automated review system flagged the stream, but it still stayed up for around 15 minutes. Favazza adds that TikTok’s automated content moderation team flagged the video “within minutes” and routed it to US moderation teams.
